text: Hello and welcome to our live coverage of the Premier League fixture between Nottingham Forest and Brighton.
Forest host the Seagulls as they look to continue their unbeaten start to the season at The City Ground (W2 D3).

Despite their impressive home form, Steve Cooper’s side currently find themselves sitting in 15th place in the Premier League table, but they could go level on points with Chelsea in 10th if they secure the three points today.
The Tricky Trees will be looking to bounce back after being defeated by West Ham United last time out before the international break.
Brighton have endured a disappointing run of form of late, failing to win in their last six games (D4 L2).
The Seagulls are sat in eighth place in the table, but could leapfrog Manchester United in sixth if they win at The City Ground.
The Seagulls drew at home to struggling Sheffield United in their last fixture, so Roberto De Zerbi will be desperate to see his side turn things around today.
Brighton have scored and conceded in their last 16 Premier League games, so we could expect plenty of goals.
Cooper has made two changes from the side who lost on the road against West Ham last time out.
In midfield, Ibrahim Sangare makes way, with Danilo coming into the starting XI.
There’s also a switch in attack, with Taiwo Awoniyi, who has been ruled out through injury, dropping out.
Wood starts up top in his place.
Meanwhile, De Zerbi has made five alterations after a disappointing performance against Sheffield United.
In goal, Steele makes way for Verbruggen.
Mahmoud Dahoud misses the game through suspension, with Adam Webster, Igor, and Buonanotte also coming out of the side.
Ferguson, Lamptey, Dunk, and Veltman all earn a place in the starting XI after missing out before the international break.
The players are making their way out onto the pitch ahead of kick-off.
The game is under way at The City Ground!
GOOOOAAAAALLLL!!!! 1-0 FOREST!! Gibbs-White burst down the right-hand side with Brighton failing to come out and press the attacking midfielder, and he stands up a cross towards the back post.
Elanga arrives unmarked and powers his header beyond the goalkeeper.
Cooper's side have an early lead!
Gibbs-White carried the ball down the right unchallenged and floated a delivery to the far post, before Elanga did the rest.
Danilo feeds the ball out wide to Elanga who cuts back onto his right and sends a cross into the penalty area.
Van Hecke is there to cut out the danger and clear.
Cooper's men are getting plenty of joy in the final third in the early proceedings, and Brighton will have to tighten up at the back to avoid conceding again.
Adingra drives through the middle of the pitch and sends the ball to Fati on the wing who looks to take on Niakhate.
The Spanish winger cuts inside and unleashes an effort from range, but it deflects behind for a corner.
Forest deal with the set-piece and are able to clear.
Brighton have enjoyed plenty of the ball since the game got under way, but have struggled to break Forest down so far.
The Seagulls have had 64.8 per cent of the possession, but are yet to test Vlachodimos between the sticks.
Gross turns superbly in the middle and floats the ball into the box.
After a scramble in the penalty area, Fati lays the ball to Gilmour on the edge of the area.
The Brighton midfielder looks to strike one from range, but he gets it all wrong and the ball goes flying over the bar.
Veltman and Lallana work the ball well on the right before Adingra wins a corner for the Seagulls.
Gross delivers it into the penalty area, but it's headed clear.
De Zerbi's side are struggling to create anything of note in the opening stages of the game, with Forest staying resolute at the back.
Ferguson wins the ball in the middle and pokes a pass into the path of Lallana who closes in on the box.
As the Brighton midfielder looks to shoot, Murillo makes a superb challenge to deny him.
Lallana will feel he should have moved the ball quicker.
Adingra cuts in from the right and sends a pass into the box.
Lallana dummies it and it falls to Ferguson with his back to goal, before he sets Gilmour up for a shot on the edge of the area.
The Brighton midfielder looks to place his strike into the corner, but Vlachodimos gets down well to save.
Fati is down and he looks like he's struggling.
The medical team are on the pitch and Brighton might have to consider making a change.
Fati can no longer continue as he hobbles off the pitch after his injury.
Joao Pedro comes on in his place.
GOOOAAAALLL!!!! 1-1! Brighton equalise! Forest look to break as Danilo sends a ball towards Gibbs-White, but Gilmour intercepts.
He passes it wide to Gross who fires it into the feet of Ferguson.
The Republic of Ireland striker takes one touch before curling his strike beyond Vlachodimos and into the bottom corner.

events.action: curling his strike beyond Vlachodimos and into the bottom corner

text: What a finish!
Gross trusted the control of Ferguson and drilled the ball into his feet, allowing him to take a touch before bending his strike beyond the goalkeeper.
Brighton are getting a little more joy now as Lamptey receives the ball out on the left and gets to the byline.
The defender clips a cross towards the back post and Adingra looks to rise above his marker, but he times his jump poorly and the delivery evades everyone.
Chance for Forest! Murillo launches a long ball beyond the Brighton defence and Gibbs-White brings it under control superbly.
The tricky midfielder dances past multiple challenges and looks to get a shot off, but it deflects behind for a corner.
Gross stands over a corner and sends it towards the front post.
Wood is there to meet it and heads the ball away, but his clearance finds Gilmour on the edge of the box.
The Brighton man attempts an ambitious effort on the volley, but it flies into the stands behind the goal.
Brighton have another potential injury issue as Lamptey drops to the floor.
It looks as though he's not going to be able to continue.
Lamptey is the second Brighton player to suffer an injury in the first half.
De Zerbi is forced into another change, with Hinshelwood entering the fray.
Gibbs-White has caused Brighton plenty of problems in the first half.
The Forest midfielder nutmegs his marker before darting past Gilmour who clips his heels, and Cooper's side have a free-kick.
Danilo works it short to Aina, but the Seagulls are equal to it and clear the danger.
A long, hopeful ball from Murillo finds Aina on the right-hand side and the Forest defender drives into the box.
Aina drills his cross into the danger zone, but it's cleared behind for a corner.
Cooper's side have looked to exploit Brighton's high line so far in this game.
Aina finds Gibbs-White with a clever pass beyond the defence, and the Forest midfielder floats a cross into the penalty area.
Wood is there to meet it, but he can't generate enough power with his header and Verbruggen is able to gather comfortably.
The fourth official has indicated that there will be a minimum of six minutes of added time at the end of the first half.
Brighton have grown into the game as we edge towards half-time.
The Seagulls have managed seven shots to Forest's five, but De Zerbi will be hoping for more from his creative players in the second half.
GOOOAAALLL!!! 2-1 BRIGHTON!! Gross is fed the ball on the right-hand side and Forest fail to apply the pressure on him.
His cross flies towards the back post and Joao Pedro rises above Aina, powering his header into the bottom corner, leaving Vlachodimos with no chance.

events.action: powering his header into the bottom corner

text: The Seagulls have turned the game around!
Gross was given too much space out wide and was able to get the ball out of his feet before delivering into the box, finding the head of Joao Pedro in the penalty area.
HALF-TIME: NOTTINGHAM FOREST 1-2 BRIGHTON
Brighton go into the break with a 2-1 lead over Forest at The City Ground.
Cooper’s side opened the scoring early on as Elanga scored a bullet header at the back post after some excellent work from Gibbs-White.
The Seagulls then found an equaliser later in the half, with Ferguson curling his strike beyond the goalkeeper from inside the box.
Just before half-time, De Zerbi’s men took the lead, with Joao Pedro heading home from Gross’ delivery.
Brighton have managed to score twice from just 0.58 expected goals (xG), with Forest staying resolute at the back for the most part.
Cooper won't be too disappointed with how his side have played, but his defenders could have done better to prevent both strikes in the first half.
If Forest are to get back into the game, Gibbs-White is likely to be the one to produce the goods.
The midfielder provided an assist for Elanga while also creating three chances.
Lallana is taken off at half-time as Brighton make their third change of the game.
Buonanotte is the player to come on in his place.
The second half is under way at The City Ground.
Brighton win a free-kick deep inside the Forest half as Murillo makes a strong challenge on Ferguson.
Dunk is standing over it and it looks as though he's going to try and test the goalkeeper.
He strikes it...
but it flies over the bar.
Joao Pedro gives the ball away in a dangerous position and Mangala drives down the right-hand side, getting to the byline.
The midfielder looks to send a cross into the box, but it's deflected behind for a corner.
Toffolo delivers to the back post and finds Danilo, but he gets his shot all wrong and it goes behind.
Toffolo goes into the book for a dangerous challenge on Buonanotte and Brighton now have a free-kick.
PENALTY TO BRIGHTON!! Gilmour sends a cross towards the back post and Dunk heads it back across goal.
Joao Pedro looks to get on the end of it, but Wood drags him to the floor and the referee points to the spot!
GOOAAAALLL!! 3-1 BRIGHTON!! Joao Pedro steps up to the plate and places his penalty into the bottom corner, sending Vlachodimos the wrong way.
The Brazilian grabs his second goal of the game! Cooper’s side have it all to do in the second half.
Forest are applying the pressure as they look to get back into the game.
Dominguez sends a looping cross towards the back post and Wood heads it back into the danger zone.
Gibbs-White looks to strike it on the volley, but Dunk flings himself in front of it to make the block.
Superb defending.
Wood hasn't had much joy in attack today, and he comes off with Origi replacing him up top.
Cooper makes an attacking change as Forest search for a goal.
Hudson-Odoi comes on in place of Danilo.
Adingra goes into the book for Brighton after he tripped Elanga as Forest looked to break.
Gibbs-White picks up the ball outside of the penalty area from the resulting free-kick, cutting inside before unleashing a long-range effort towards goal.
It deflects out for a corner and Gibbs-White is the man to deliver, but Brighton deal with it comfortably and are able to clear.
Cooper brings on some fresh legs in midfield, with Yates replacing Dominguez in the second half.
VAR are checking whether Forest should have had a penalty.
Hinshelwood dragged Hudson-Odoi to the ground in the box, but the referee initially waved play on.
He's now checking it at the monitor...
PENALTY GIVEN!!
Dunk is given a yellow card for dissent after appealing against the penalty decision.
Dunk is given his marching orders! Seconds after Anthony Taylor gave him a yellow, the Brighton defender receives a red! Dunk must have said something that the referee wasn't happy with.
Ferguson also receives a yellow for dissent after appealing to the referee following the penalty.
Niakhate also goes into the referee's book for dissent.
GOOOOAAAALLL 3-2!! Forest pull one back! Gibbs-White dispatches his penalty into the bottom corner, sending Verbruggen the wrong way.
There was plenty of pressure on the midfielder after a long delay.
Cooper’s side are back in it!
Brighton bring on some fresh legs in the middle of the park, with Baleba replacing Gilmour.
Ferguson is replaced by Moder as De Zerbi makes another change.
It's backs against the wall for Brighton now as Forest look to find an equaliser with wave after wave of attacks.
Elanga and Hudson-Odoi are causing plenty of problems with their pace out wide, and the Seagulls are struggling to get out of their half.
Verbruggen goes into the book for timewasting, with Brighton desperately trying to hold onto their lead.
Gross sends a corner into the box and van Hecke rises above the defender before powering a header towards goal.
Unfortunately for Brighton, it's straight at the goalkeeper, who holds comfortably.
Big chance for Forest! Hudson-Odoi receives the ball out wide and stands up his marker.
The Forest winger clips a cross into the box and Gibbs-White is in the penalty area unmarked, but he gets his header all wrong and it flies behind for a goal-kick.
He will feel he should have at least hit the target from there!
Cooper rolls the dice late on, bringing on Williams in place of Aina.
The fourth official has indicated that there will be a minimum of 10 minutes of added time at the end of the second half.
Buonanotte is the latest player to go into the referee's book in the final few minutes of the game.
Forest are applying plenty of pressure late on, pumping balls into the box, but Brighton have been able to deal with it.
The City Ground supporters are urging their players on, but Cooper's men can't find a breakthrough.
Just a few minutes left to find an equaliser!
Forest have a late corner and Gibbs-White sends a cross into the box, with Cooper's side flooding the penalty area with bodies.
Once again, Brighton are able to clear the danger, with The City Ground growing increasingly frustrated.
What a chance for Forest! Hudson-Odoi clips a cross towards the back post and Elanga guides the ball into the box.
Yates flings himself at it and powers a header towards the top corner, but Verbruggen makes a superb save to prevent a goal!
Yellow Card Pascal Groß
FULL-TIME: NOTTINGHAM FOREST 2-3 BRIGHTON

Brighton manage to hold on despite late pressure from Forest, winning 3-2 at The City Ground! Ferguson and Elanga’s first-half goals cancelled each other out, with the Seagulls going into the break with a 2-1 lead after substitute Joao Pedro fired home in the final few seconds of the half.
The Brazilian then dispatched from the penalty spot to score Brighton’s third after half-time.
Cooper’s side were awarded a penalty later in the second half, and Dunk was subsequently given his marching orders after a heated conversation with the referee.
Forest couldn’t find an equaliser despite late pressure.
De Zerbi’s side finally end their winless run and will face Chelsea next in the Premier League.
Cooper’s side will look to bounce back next week as they host Everton.
That’s all for today, goodbye!
